title: EKG Report
description: A resting 12-lead electrocardiogram (EKG/ECG) report, as a clinician, underwriter or cardiology data pipeline reads it: whose recording it is, when and on what device it was taken, the machine's interval measurements, its interpretation statements, and the recording settings. The waveform traces themselves are not extracted.

report_title.description: The report's title from the top of the page, e.g. '3x4 Simultaneous ECG Report'.

patient.description: The Patient Details block at the top left.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth exactly as printed (do not reformat).

age_years.description: Age in years, from the parenthesised age beside the date of birth.

height.description: Height exactly as printed, with units.

weight.description: Weight exactly as printed, with units.

recorded_at.description: Date and time the ECG was recorded, exactly as printed (do not reformat).

device.description: Recording device identifier exactly as printed.

location.description: Recording location as printed; null if blank.

measurements.description: The Measurements block: the machine-measured rate, intervals and axes.

heart_rate_bpm.description: Heart rate in beats per minute.

p_qrs_t_axes.description: The P, QRS and T axes exactly as printed, e.g. '10°, 20°, 30°'.

status.description: The status in the Interpretation heading's parentheses, e.g. 'Unconfirmed' or 'Confirmed'.

statements.description: Every interpretation statement, in order. A statement that wraps onto a second line is one statement.

code.description: The numeric statement code printed before the text, as printed, keeping leading zeros (e.g. '004').

text.description: The statement text without its code, joined across any line wrap.

comments.description: Text under the Comments heading; null if blank.

settings.description: Recording and display settings printed along the bottom of the tracing.

paper_speed.description: Paper speed exactly as printed, e.g. '25.0 mm/s'.

gain.description: Amplitude scale exactly as printed, e.g. '10.0 mm/mV'.

filters.description: Filter band exactly as printed, without the 'Filters:' label, e.g. '0.05 - 150 Hz'.

leads.description: The lead labels shown on the tracing grid, in reading order (left to right, top to bottom), including any rhythm strip lead.
